clinic_mkt.title: Connections
clinic_mkt.lead: Connect your clinic's social accounts, its Google profile and its own measurement pixels. Each clinic connects its own; changes apply to your clinic's pages at once.
clinic_mkt.social_sub: Shown as icons in your website footer and declared to search engines as the clinic's profiles.
clinic_mkt.google_sub: Your clinic's Google Maps profile, a write-a-review link and site-ownership verification codes.
clinic_mkt.verify_help: In Search Console choose “URL prefix” with your clinic website's address, then the “HTML tag” method and paste the code (or the whole tag).
clinic_mkt.pixels_sub: Measure visits to your clinic website and your ad results. Enter the ID only, not the whole snippet.
clinic_mkt.pixels_privacy: Pixels load only on your clinic website pages, and only after the visitor accepts measurement cookies on your notice. They never load on booking, sign-in or app pages, and no patient data is sent.
clinic_mkt.err_link: Enter a valid https link for this network.
clinic_mkt.err_google: Enter a Google link (google.com, g.page or maps.app.goo.gl).
clinic_mkt.err_code: Invalid code — letters and numbers only.
clinic_mkt.err_pixel: The ID does not match this pixel’s format.
